direction.summary: Turn exact PENDING_REVIEW provider evidence receipts into explicit durable Execution review decisions, exact reviewed-source handoff, MarkReg-owned customer-safe lifecycle projection and explainable non-executing Recommended Actions without external filing or Official Truth authority.

decisionAlternatives.reason: Directly continues the M4 PENDING_REVIEW boundary and closes the customer Status/Evidence/Lifecycle Beta loop using reviewed durable truth.
Capability learning should consume reviewed lifecycle outcomes rather than raw Provider Return evidence; durable reviewed outcome provenance should come first.
Finance does not close the reviewed-evidence/customer-lifecycle loop and Payment remains separate from performance, authority and completion.
External filing and office truth require separate protected-action, credential and official-source architecture.
Messaging/reminders should consume durable lifecycle and recommendation state rather than own or invent lifecycle truth.

semanticBoundaries.providerReturn: MGSN-owned provider assertion/evidence; not Official Truth
semanticBoundaries.evidenceReceipt: Execution-owned durable evidence receipt; PENDING_REVIEW means received for review, not externally verified
semanticBoundaries.evidenceReviewDecision: Execution-owned explicit internal review truth bound to an exact receipt version/fingerprint; not office acceptance
semanticBoundaries.correctionRequest: Execution-owned review result requesting corrected evidence while preserving historical Provider Return lineage
semanticBoundaries.reviewedSourceAdmission: bounded exact reviewed source allowed for downstream internal use; not Filing Submission or Official Truth
semanticBoundaries.lifecycleEventProjection: MarkReg-owned customer-relevant projection from governed admitted sources; not a second official source
semanticBoundaries.currentLifecycleView: deterministic MarkReg projection of durable lifecycle events
semanticBoundaries.recommendedAction: explainable advisory candidate; not authorization or execution

persistence.handoffRequirement: exact-version/fingerprint APIs with safe retry, replay and response-loss recovery

primaryAcceptanceJourney: authenticate authorized reviewer and customer principals
load exact current PENDING_REVIEW Execution evidence receipt
record explicit durable Evidence Review Decision
when correction is required preserve exact evidence and Provider Return lineage
when admitted expose exact reviewed source for bounded internal downstream use
hand reviewed source to MarkReg without cross-service SQL
persist durable Lifecycle Event and deterministic Current Lifecycle View
produce explainable non-executing Recommended Action candidate
restart runtimes and replay exact handoff without duplicate business state
prove finance, legal appointment, Filing Submission, Official Truth, automatic Matter completion and Capability consequences remain false

authorityConsequences.evidenceReviewDecisionCreated: may become true only after explicit authorized Execution review command
authorityConsequences.correctionRequested: may become true only after explicit review decision requiring correction
authorityConsequences.reviewedSourceAdmitted: may become true only for exact evidence explicitly admitted for bounded internal use
authorityConsequences.lifecycleProjectionCreated: may become true only after exact admitted reviewed-source handoff
authorityConsequences.recommendedActionCreated: may become true as a non-executing advisory record from governed lifecycle state
